source.raw_text: Repeated delivery of the same provider message is different from two distinct messages containing identical text.

cases.interpretation: The provider-scoped immutable message key, not body text, determines redelivery identity.
confirmed_facts: A transport can redeliver one provider message.

source.raw_text: ORDER DK sapra/Mukesh LOT 42076/ 5 CRT Lotb42074/ 10 CRT Total 15 crate Vehicle no Anil Tempo

cases.interpretation: Two exported records contain identical text at the same displayed timestamp; the export has no provider message IDs proving redelivery.
confirmed_facts: Two distinct transcript records exist.
Their normalized text is identical.

expected_result_review.basis: Manual comparison of transcript records; no provider identity inferred.

source.raw_text: Payment Date - 11-09-2026 Amount - ₹ 20850.00 Payment Ref # - 4RHDMB0010292127 Status - Authorization InProcess

cases.interpretation: The same transaction reference is posted in two export records. Evidence identity and financial transaction identity are separate questions.
confirmed_facts: The displayed payment date, amount, and reference repeat.
Both source records say Authorization InProcess.

expected_result_review.basis: Exact transcript references reviewed; no clearing receipt reviewed.

source.raw_text: One message can have multiple attachments.

cases.interpretation: Message uniqueness must not force a one-to-one relationship between Evidence and attachments.
confirmed_facts: The readiness contract must support attachment cardinality greater than one.

expected_result_review.basis: Schema requirement reviewed; not asserted as an observation from the export.

cases.interpretation: The amendment has quantity and lot but no validated parent order reference.
confirmed_facts: Quantity 10 and lot 42088 are explicit.
No parent identifier is explicit.

expected_result_review.basis: No parent match invented from message adjacency.

cases.interpretation: The amendment has quantity and lot but no validated parent order reference.
confirmed_facts: Quantity 50 and lot 42088 are explicit.
No parent identifier is explicit.

expected_result_review.basis: No parent match invented from message adjacency.

source.raw_text: ORDER AZAD / SNS 20 Box Lot 42076 Vishal Tempo; request follows that sale price is needed

cases.interpretation: Buyer alias, quantity, lot, and vehicle are extractable, but rate is absent.
confirmed_facts: The order text contains no rate.
A later message explicitly asks for sale prices.

expected_result_review.basis: Missing rate preserved; no rate inferred from nearby orders.

source.raw_text: ORDER DK sapra/Mukesh LOT 42076/ 5 CRT Lotb42074/ 10 CRT Total 15 crate Vehicle no Anil Tempo

cases.interpretation: One commercial order contains two lot lines and one total quantity.
confirmed_facts: Lot 42076 quantity 5 is explicit.
Lot 42074 quantity 10 is explicit.
Total quantity 15 is explicit.

expected_result_review.basis: Line quantities reconcile to the explicit total; buyer identity and rate remain unresolved.

source.raw_text: Hold Gatepass contradiction: ledger marked HOLD while physical outward evidence was reported to show dispatch.

cases.interpretation: The chat asserts a ledger/physical conflict, but the summary alone is not the underlying gatepass evidence.
confirmed_facts: A source conflict was reported for 200 crates.

expected_result_review.basis: Underlying GP rows must be matched before changing physical state.

source.raw_text: ORDER PRAFULL S 5 Crate Lot 42076 By hand

cases.interpretation: By hand is a positive dispatch mode, not a missing vehicle value.
confirmed_facts: Quantity 5, lot 42076, and dispatch mode By hand are explicit.

expected_result_review.basis: Chat extraction exact; attachment match remains a candidate until explicitly accepted.

source.raw_text: AU; NAME / DATE CHECK; Candidate GP 205952: ALI MARKET, 15-Sep

cases.interpretation: The workbook proposes a candidate alias match but does not establish identity.
confirmed_facts: The row is explicitly marked NAME / DATE CHECK.

expected_result_review.basis: Candidate label preserved; no Customer mapping inferred.

cases.interpretation: Commercial sale date and physical outward date may legitimately differ; neither may overwrite the other.
confirmed_facts: The reviewed workbook records distinct sale and outward dates.

expected_result_review.basis: No date normalized or silently replaced.

source.raw_text: Payments for plum or grapes or both? First adjust in plum then grapes. Extra amount to go into grapes account? Yes.

cases.interpretation: The conversation confirms allocation order at container/category level, not a per-receipt allocation or bank clearing result.
confirmed_facts: Plum-first then grapes allocation was explicitly confirmed.

expected_result_review.basis: Confirmation scope limited to what the chat actually states.

source.raw_text: Payment Date - 03-09-2026 Amount - ₹ 250000.00 Payment Type - RTGS Status - Authorization InProcess

cases.interpretation: Authorization InProcess is not verified settlement or cleared receipt.
confirmed_facts: The raw bank status is Authorization InProcess.

expected_result_review.basis: Raw status preserved; no settlement evidence inferred.

source.raw_text: Cold storage bills not received ussko zero kar doo we add later when we got complete sales of plum.

cases.interpretation: A provisional display zero must not become a verified zero expense.
confirmed_facts: The cold-storage bill was reported not received.

expected_result_review.basis: Missing cost remains UNKNOWN even if an output view uses a provisional zero.

source.raw_text: Paid almost 80 K extra to our CHA; FSSAI and PQ charges may be automatically exempted but were said to be charged in full.

cases.interpretation: This is a user-reported claim requiring shipment-specific receipts and exemption checks before any recoverable amount is asserted.
confirmed_facts: The approximately ₹80,000 claim appears in the chat.
An image is attached to the claim.

expected_result_review.basis: Claim recorded without independent verification; no CHA module authorized.

source.raw_text: Six attachment records appear across two displayed timestamps.

cases.interpretation: Equal displayed timestamps do not establish one provider message or one attachment bundle.
confirmed_facts: Six distinct archive members are referenced.

expected_result_review.basis: No grouping inferred from timestamp equality.

source.raw_text: No incomplete attachment may be marked successfully captured.

cases.interpretation: Transport completion, expected length, byte hash, durable write, and readback are distinct checkpoints.
confirmed_facts: Partial-download behavior is a required readiness scenario.

expected_result_review.basis: Failure contract reviewed; no downloader implemented.

source.raw_text: Document human correction and rejected matches.

cases.interpretation: Corrections append reviewed provenance; they do not overwrite raw evidence or erase rejected candidates.
confirmed_facts: Human correction and rejection behavior is a required readiness scenario.

expected_result_review.basis: Correction contract reviewed; no correction workflow implemented.
